content.text: Note: The ocfl-java update uses the S3 Transfer Manager and we want to make sure this continues to work with old installations as we don’t intend this to be a major release.
First step on this is to upgrade to 2.0.1 and handle namespace updates.
First step PRs have been merged.
PRs updating to ocfl 2.1.0 were tested against s3 and have been merged.
which brings performance improvements to s3 writes.
